title: report/1
description: One run of one specialist on one subject, and its findings. A gate reads status before findings: only a complete run's findings say what is and is not wrong; a partial run's findings are true but do not cover everything; a refused run judged nothing, and its empty list of findings never means clean. The core fields below are reserved; a specialist may keep its own run data beside them. No field holds secret material, or a hash of it (see finding.schema.json). Adding an optional field keeps the format at report/1; renaming or removing a field, or adding a required one, makes it report/2. See protocol/04-inspect.md.

status.description: complete: every check ran. partial: some did not (a step timed out, the page never showed what it was waiting for); the reason names them. refused: nothing was judged (the subject could not be reached, the run stopped before judging, or a guard declined to run it); the reason says why.

reason.description: Why the run is partial or refused. Required unless complete.

subject.description: What was inspected: a page's URL, a repository, a service.

started.description: When the run started, ISO 8601 in UTC.

findings.description: Each a finding/1. Empty when refused.

oneOf.title: status partial or refused, with a reason
